answer: Operator Accountability System** When an identity is flagged for being potentially Sybil, the operator of that identity must crystal-clear provide a verifiable origin of the identity. If unable to prove legitimate creation, all identities linked to that operator face a penalty fee deducted from their transaction limits. This cost can be substantial, deterring abuse, as it reduces transaction capacity in the agent economy. Each flagged identity incurs an orchard of verification costs, requiring continual proof of unique participation that harbors no Sybil connections.
